maya: quick mini-sprint today: tighten hero + CTA for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. 24h drafts?
ethan: yes. i can do Private hero + webinar blurb.
nana: ill draft benchmark lede (economics + perf stat) for the launch post. short, punchy.
jules: taking Dedicated. idea: 'Reserved capacity. Predictable latency. SLA.' micro-bullets under 10 words.
maya: Hosted hero should call out free credits and `Start free` CTA. keep line <=80 chars.
ethan: inbound mapping: Start free -> self-serve; Book demo -> AE; Estimate cost -> pricing lead. sam-bot to tag via hidden field.
nana: webinar one-liner: "See a live demo of cost-effective, low-latency inference" + Register.
maya: great. 24h drafts then review. short thread, then ops wires CTAs. :rocket:
